answer.justification: Every logit-level measure is exactly at the identical-model value: top-1 and sequence agreement are 1.000, KL, TV and Token-DiFR gap are 0.000, and raw-score shift ÷ TV is undefined (0 ÷ 0). Quantized has KL 0.039 or higher and top-1 agreement 0.955 or lower. Fine-tuned and system-prompted shift more than that. Any tampering would produce a non-zero value, so the unknown model is the reference itself. Output and activation levels were not measured, but the logit evidence alone is decisive.
